newsitem.title: USA: Planet Hollywood comfortable with 97/98 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Planet Hollywood comfortable with 97/98 estimates.

text.p: Planet Hollywood International Inc President and Chief Executive Officer Robert Earl said he was comfortable with earnings per share estimates of $0.70 and $0.95 for 1997 and 1998, respectively, on existing cash flows alone.
"The existing cash flows from the business builds out that growth, but we're not a company that's just going to sit still," he told Reuters after a presentation to investors.
"That doesn't require any funding whatsoever, not even using (the company's $50 million untapped) bank line. We have no borrowings and we're a very aggressive, proactive company."

Among new projects are a music theme along side its Planet Hollywood film star and All Star athletic hero restaurant and retail concept. He also said the company is in deals over toy products expected to produce profitable revenue streams in 1997, a credit card arrangement and plans to soon unveil a Web site in partnership with two Silicon Valley companies.
He said the latter would "continue this successful formula of taking other people's money to use on our trademark."
Earl said theme dining now accounts for less than one percent of the $60 billion dinner restaurant business, which could grow to more than 10 percent in the future.
